_doc: Emerald's rematches (emerald_rematch 2026-10-18, notes/EMERALD_REMATCH.md). Generated by converter/gen_trainers.py (HOENN_VERSION=emerald) from pokeemerald src/battle_setup.c gRematchTable: "rows" = the 73 trainers who rematch (64 route trainers, the 8 Gym Leaders = gym 1-8, Wally at Victory Road = gym 9, a post-game row; gym 0 = a route trainer; rows and slots are only appended), each with its first battle's Black 2 id (b2_id; partner: Liza's for Tate & Liza) and its tiers 2-5 (slot = the rematch slot of the tier, Tate & Liza: slot = Tate's half, slot + 1 = Liza's); "slots" = what each rematch slot holds (src/trainers/emerald_rematch/NNN_*.s, installed by b2tools/patches/emerald_rematch.py). Rematch slots are not Black 2 trainer ids: the battle keeps the first battle's id, name, picture, NPC and flag. Message types of the first battle's trainer: 100 intro, 101 post, 102 cannot, 103 defeat, 104 intro2, 105 post2, 106 cannot2.
